# Writing

- Every piece of English text — code comments, documentation, commit messages, PR descriptions, Jira issues, UI strings, chat replies in English — is written in [Simplified Technical English](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Simplified_Technical_English) (ASD-STE100).
- The constraints are countable, not a mood: one word carries one meaning and one meaning gets one word (pick "start" or "launch" and keep it, no synonym variety); active voice; imperative for an instruction, one instruction per sentence; present tense; at most 20 words in a procedural sentence and 25 in a descriptive one; noun clusters of at most three words; no dropped articles; a pronoun only where its noun is the previous one.
- This is a rule about English, not about which language to answer in. Russian conversation stays Russian.

# MCP Servers
